title: physical-4 to logical-16 attention heads
hypothesis: Four physical QKV sets expanded into sixteen logical heads with per-head Mirror coordinates can recover a shared-view 16-head teacher at lower actual payload than ordinary 16-head MHA; hard GQA and generated low-rank residuals are the controls.
physical_object: four QKV projection sets from 32D input to 2D heads
mirror_coordinate: per-logical-head Givens coordinates on the 32D input, with logical heads grouped over four physical QKV sets
logical_multiplicity: sixteen attention heads from four physical QKV sets

teacher_modes.shared4_view16: four physical QKV sets reused across sixteen logical heads with Givens views

controls: hard GQA with four shared physical QKV sets repeated across groups
four physical sets plus generated per-logical-head rank-1 QKV residuals
four physical sets plus per-head Mirror views

development.selection_metric: mean held-out output MSE pooled across methods and both teacher modes

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save state_dict plus deterministic config JSON

success_gate: In all three fresh shared4-view16 worlds, Mirror output MSE <=1.10x full MHA and payload <=0.65x full MHA; it must beat hard GQA and low-rank residual controls on output MSE. Head contribution audit and compute/runtime must be reported.
failure_gate: Mirror misses aggregate quality or payload gates in two or more fresh aligned worlds, or a simpler control matches quality at equal/lower payload and compute. Independent16 failure alone is a structural boundary.
boundaries: shared4-view16 teacher is intentionally aligned to Givens views
no NLL or downstream task claim
